faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Quick answers before you visit. Anything else, just call or schedule a viewing.

deposit.q: How much is the deposit and advance?
deposit.a: [TO CONFIRM: deposit amount] deposit and [TO CONFIRM: advance, e.g. 1 month] advance, paid on move-in. After that, rent is due every month on your move-in day.

included.q: What's included in the rent? How are water and electricity split?
included.a: Your own bed and locker, an air-conditioned room and free Wi-Fi. Water and electricity are billed at actual usage and split equally among the roommates; your share shows up in the renter portal.

visitors.q: Can I have visitors? Is there a curfew?
visitors.a: Visitors are welcome. Quiet hours are from 10 PM to 6 AM, and overnight guests need prior notice. [TO CONFIRM: curfew time, or "no curfew"].

payment.a: In the renter portal: pay by GCash, Maya or BPI to the account shown there, then upload your proof of payment. Cash is recorded by the owner [TO CONFIRM: where and when cash is handed over].
